scientific_question: At a full 200x-valid paired-MLP budget, can bounded activation-conditioned diagonal modulation of each complete atom's residual coordinates recover directions and local tangents that global positive and signed atom coefficients cannot?

theory_reconciliation.new_measurement: The sealed signed four-atom span reaches only 0.375051/0.376216 mean heldout recovery, -0.267507/-0.270619 JVP recovery, +0.004379/+0.004934 over its static control, +0.002746/+0.002688 over the positive-simplex parent, and 0.728020 cross-bank action cosine.
theory_reconciliation.revised_diagnosis: The fitted signed coefficient absolute mean equals its ordinary mean and coefficient JVP RMS is only 0.00224--0.00312. Removing positivity does not produce useful cancellation. The binding restriction is that one global scalar per complete atom cannot rotate its 768-dimensional residual write.
theory_reconciliation.single_causal_change: Replace global activation-conditioned atom coefficients with a bounded activation-conditioned diagonal on every residual output coordinate of each complete atom. Static atom averaging, procedural FHT c_fc/c_proj maps, channel gains, shared hidden bias, data, optimizer, and evaluation remain fixed in kind.
theory_reconciliation.why_three_atoms: A conditional diagonal for each output coordinate consumes the coordinates freed by reducing four atoms to three. Three atoms are the maximum complete-atom count that keeps all learned state above 200x compression; this is a preregistered budget allocation, not an atom-count sweep.
theory_reconciliation.why_not_the_rejected_context_gate: The rejected internal context gate perturbed a linear c_fc map and was nearly orthogonal to its linear residual. Here modulation acts after the complete c_fc-GELU-c_proj nonlinear function and directly changes the 768-dimensional residual-write direction.
theory_reconciliation.paper_connection: The original Mapping Networks mechanism relies on latent modulation of fixed orthogonal maps plus smooth/Lipschitz local geometry. The bounded tanh coordinate feature and learned per-channel modulation implement that principle without a dense learned basis.

source.terminal_gauge: Use the exact terminal model, routing, targets, discovery banks, heldout bank, and analytic JVP probes used by the sealed complete-atom controls.

signed_complete_atom_result.finding: Signed global atom coefficients add less than 0.005 recovery over a static span and leave the analytic JVP strongly negative.

positive_simplex_result.finding: Positive-simplex activation routing adds only about 0.0024 recovery over the identical static mixture.

maximum_budget_kfac_result.finding: The strongest stable static 200x chart reaches only 0.433036/0.426122 mean recovery.

candidate.name: three_complete_atoms_with_residual_coordinate_modulation
candidate.outer_router_scope: The source top-2 router is unchanged and independently counted. Every c_fc and c_proj matrix of all eight complete experts is removed.

same_run_control.name: static_three_complete_atom_average
same_run_control.single_difference: Freeze every residual-coordinate modulation b at zero; fit the identical three fixed atoms, hidden/output gains, and shared hidden bias.
same_run_control.purpose: Isolate coordinate-wise activation conditioning from static three-atom capacity.

data_protocol.sampling: Reuse exact terminal outer routing and deterministic per-expert sampling. Candidate and static control receive identical inputs, JVP probes, and dense targets.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and probes never affect coordinates, stopping, initialization, thresholds, or candidate selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on all counted hidden/output gains, shared hidden biases, and eligible residual-coordinate modulation vectors
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert normalized residual-output MSE plus 0.10 normalized analytic input-JVP MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection or atom/sign/activation/modulation-scale/LR/step/seed/threshold sweep.

evaluation.primary: Exact outer-routed dense-teacher residual-output recovery on untouched heldout activations.
evaluation.local: Analytic input-JVP recovery including the derivative of the bounded residual-coordinate modulation.
evaluation.expert: Score every source expert before outer top-2 aggregation.
evaluation.stability: Compare heldout outer-routed actions from independently fitted discovery A/B candidates by cosine.
evaluation.causal: Compare the candidate with its same-run static three-atom control and the sealed, more favorable four-atom signed candidate.

decision_rule.pass: Passing every gate in both banks authorizes only a production implementation/count/correctness phase and a separately preregistered initialization-plus-Mapping-Loss shadow. It does not authorize LM training directly.
decision_rule.fail: Reject this exact residual-coordinate modulation family. Do not sweep atom count, signs, tanh/feature activation, modulation scale, LR, steps, seeds, regularization, or thresholds. Return to theory before another full-MLP candidate.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact two-step GPU preflight. If projected or observed full runtime exceeds five minutes, use a verified terminal/error-only @Codex watcher launched through examples/nanogpt/launch_local_detached.py.
